modalLead: Response-time trends for network checks, cleaner page titles and a digest that opens in plain sentences.

items.text: Response-time trends for network checks. A check that measures milliseconds shows its last day as a small line, and opening it draws 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days.
Cleaner page titles. A login word or the site's own name is taken off a suggested title, and a small arrow brings the original back.
The digest opens with the week in plain sentences.
Watch feeds badge stays clickable until the news is read. The news window is one hour by default.
Inbox rows that load late still rise in.
